coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across five complementary angles: (1) Foundational psychology of control and agency (Rotter's locus of control, Bandura's self-efficacy, Csikszentmihalyi's flow and challenge-skill balance); (2) Seminal HCI theory on user control and predictability (Shneiderman's direct manipulation & autonomy principles, Norman's design principles & affordances, situated cognition via Suchman); (3) Values-centered design (Nissenbaum contextual integrity, Friedman value-sensitive design); (4) Contemporary HCI empirics on sense of agency, transparency, automation bias, and human-AI collaboration (CHI/UIST/TOCHI papers, Frontiers reviews, arXiv recent work 2024-2025); (5) Applied domain research on decision support systems, visual analytics, recommendation systems, and adaptive interfaces. Deduplication performed across overlapping author citations and topic clusters. Coverage includes T0 systematic reviews/meta-analyses, T1 peer-reviewed CHI/UIST/TOCHI/arXiv, T2 seminal books (Norman, Csikszentmihalyi, Tufte, Munzner, Suchman), and T3 practitioner essays. Open-access sources (Frontiers, arXiv, MIT Press excerpts) marked as redistribute-ok; paywalled ACM DL and springer articles marked as reference-only. Notable gaps: limited coverage of control in embodied/haptic systems (tangible UIs touched but not deeply), emerging neuroscience of agency (some Frontiers articles), and longitudinal studies on sustained agency in long-term system use.

sources.title: Locus of Control Theory In Psychology: Internal vs External
sources.notes: Foundational reference to Julian B. Rotter's 1966 Psychological Monographs seminal work on locus of control; introduces internal vs external control dimension as core personality construct with implications for sense of agency and personal causality beliefs.

sources.title: The experience of agency in human-computer interactions: a review
sources.notes: Comprehensive Frontiers review by Limerick, Coyle, Moore on sense of agency in HCI; covers perception of control, causality, and system feedback mechanisms; bridges neuroscience and interaction design.

sources.title: The Tangible User Interface and its Evolution
sources.notes: Hiroshi Ishii's seminal work on embodied interaction and tangible user interfaces; demonstrates how physical control enhances sense of agency and directness in human-computer systems.

sources.title: Direct Manipulation: A Fundamental Element of Graphical User Interfaces
sources.notes: Ben Shneiderman's 1983 foundational work establishing direct manipulation principles (continuous visibility, physical actions, rapid reversible feedback); core theory for user control and predictability.

sources.title: Ben Shneiderman on User Autonomy and Control
sources.notes: Shneiderman's Rules of Interface Design emphasizing internal locus of control and user autonomy; foundational principles for maintaining user agency in interactive systems.

sources.title: Human-Centered AI: Ensuring Human Control While Increasing Automation
sources.notes: Shneiderman's 2022 Oxford University Press book introducing two-dimensional HCAI framework separating human control from automation levels; argues for high control + high automation designs to maintain agency.

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things (Revised Edition)
sources.notes: Donald Norman's seminal work on design principles including affordances, feedback, constraints, and mental models; establishes design foundations for user control and sense of agency.

sources.title: Emotional Design: Why We Love (Or Hate) Everyday Things
sources.notes: Norman's three-level design framework (visceral, behavioral, reflective); behavioral level emphasizes flow, control, and mastery as drivers of user satisfaction and agency.

sources.title: Flow: The Psychology of Optimal Experience
sources.notes: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi's foundational 1990 book introducing flow state theory; establishes challenge-skill balance, control, and clear goals as prerequisites for optimal experience and agency.

sources.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
sources.notes: Edward Tufte's seminal 1982/1983 data visualization work establishing principles of information clarity; argues for user control through meaningful visual representation and data-ink ratio.

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
sources.notes: Tamara Munzner's comprehensive visualization theory textbook; emphasizes interaction idioms, user-controllable variables, and exploratory design supporting iterative user agency in data analysis.

sources.title: Plans and Situated Actions: The Problem of Human-Machine Communication
sources.notes: Lucy Suchman's foundational 1987 work challenging plan-based cognitive models; argues situated action theory emphasizes context, opportunism, and user agency over rigid pre-specification.

sources.title: Information Foraging Theory
sources.notes: Peter Pirolli and Stuart Card's information foraging theory; models user agency in information seeking through scent-driven adaptive behavior, patches, and diet; foundational for search and browsing design.

sources.title: Self-Efficacy: The Exercise of Control
sources.notes: Albert Bandura's 1997 comprehensive treatment of self-efficacy as belief in one's capacity to execute actions; foundational psychological theory underlying perceived control and agency in technology use.

sources.title: Values in Design
sources.notes: Helen Nissenbaum's values in design framework (with Friedman); advocates designing for autonomy, privacy, and informed consent as core values; contextual integrity model for privacy-preserving agency.

sources.title: Value Sensitive Design and Information Systems
sources.notes: Batya Friedman and David Hendry's foundational HCI methodology integrating human values (autonomy, control, informed consent) into design through conceptual, empirical, and technical investigations.

sources.title: The sense of agency in emerging technologies for human–computer integration: A review
sources.notes: Extended Frontiers review on sense of agency in emerging technologies; covers neural mechanisms, interface feedback, transparency, and control in contemporary systems including AI.

sources.title: User Autonomy: Who Should Control What and When?
sources.notes: CHI 1996 foundational workshop on user autonomy and authority allocation in human-computer systems; establishes framework for control delegation and user agency in interactive systems.

sources.title: Visioning Human-Agentic AI Teaming: Continuity, Tension, and Future Research
sources.notes: Contemporary 2026 arXiv paper examining dynamics of human-AI collaboration; addresses tensions between human autonomy and agentic AI system control; future research directions for shared agency.

sources.title: User Autonomy in Human-LLM Interaction: A Scoping Review
sources.notes: Recent 2025 scoping review mapping user autonomy conceptualization and technical support in LLM systems; systematic synthesis of how user control mechanisms are designed into conversational AI.

sources.title: Human-AI collaboration is not very collaborative yet: a taxonomy of interaction patterns in AI-assisted decision making from a systematic review
sources.notes: 2024 Frontiers systematic review of human-AI collaboration patterns in decision support; reveals control asymmetries and identifies gaps between desired and actual user agency in AI systems.

sources.title: From Explainable to Interactive AI: A Literature Review on Current Trends in Human-AI Interaction
sources.notes: 2024 arXiv literature review tracking evolution from explainability to interactive AI; establishes connections between transparency and user control; documents XAI frameworks and their role in agency.

sources.title: Sense of Agency and User Experience: Is There a Link?
sources.notes: ACM TOCHI empirical study establishing relationship between sense of agency and user satisfaction; demonstrates system feedback and control mechanisms impact perceived agency.

sources.title: Human Factors Considerations in the Design and Evaluation of Flight Deck Displays and Controls
sources.notes: FAA/Volpe Center human factors guidance on aviation automation design; addresses mode awareness, situation awareness, and maintaining pilot agency in highly automated cockpits.

sources.title: Human-Automation Interaction Research: Past, Present, and Future
sources.notes: Comprehensive review of human-automation research trajectory; covers automation bias, loss of situation awareness, and design approaches maintaining meaningful human control and agency.

sources.title: User-controllable Recommendation Against Filter Bubbles
sources.notes: 2022 arXiv on controllable recommender systems; addresses tension between personalization and user agency; demonstrates user control mechanisms enable diversity and serendipity.

sources.title: Design of a Serendipity-Incorporated Recommender System
sources.notes: 2025 MDPI article on balancing algorithmic optimization with user discovery and agency; addresses how recommendation systems can support user exploration and choice.

sources.title: Regulatory CI: Adaptively Regulating Privacy as Contextual Integrity
sources.notes: Nissenbaum's contextual integrity framework for privacy; establishes norms-based approach to user control over information flows; applicable to data agency and autonomy.

sources.title: Conventions and Commitments in Distributed CSCW Groups
sources.notes: Gloria Mark's CSCW research on group awareness and coordination mechanisms; addresses shared control, responsibility distribution, and collective agency in collaborative systems.

sources.title: Human-AI Team Interaction
sources.notes: National Academies of Sciences report chapter on human-AI team interaction; discusses authority allocation, complementary teaming, and maintaining human oversight and control.

sources.title: Human-Centered Human-AI Collaboration (HCHAC)
sources.notes: 2025 framework for human-centered AI collaboration emphasizing shared agency, meaningful control, and complementary capabilities; addresses design principles for balanced AI-human authority.

sources.title: Seeing to Think? How Source Transparency Design Shapes Interactive Information Seeking and Evaluation in Conversational AI
sources.notes: 2026 arXiv on transparency in conversational AI; demonstrates how source visibility affects user's sense of agency and ability to evaluate and override AI recommendations.

sources.title: Teachable Agents for End-User Empowerment in Personalized Feed Curation
sources.notes: 2024 research on teachable agents enabling user control over algorithmic curation; demonstrates explicit user teaching mechanisms preserve agency in personalization.

sources.title: Bias in the Loop: How Humans Evaluate AI-Generated Suggestions
sources.notes: 2025 arXiv examining cognitive biases in human evaluation of AI; addresses how user agency and critical evaluation interact with system design in collaborative decision-making.

sources.title: Beyond Omakase: Designing Shared Control for Navigation Robots with Blind People
sources.notes: 2025 arXiv on shared control in robotic systems; examines dynamic authority allocation and user agency in safety-critical autonomous systems; design principles for collaborative control.

sources.title: Synergizing Human-AI Agency: A Guide of 23 Heuristics for Service Co-Creation with LLM-Based Agents
sources.notes: 2023 arXiv with 23 design heuristics for human-AI co-creation; emphasizes user agency, transparency, and meaningful control in LLM agent design.

sources.title: "When to Hand Off, When to Work Together": Expanding Human-Agent Co-Creative Collaboration through Concurrent Interaction
sources.notes: 2026 arXiv on dynamic control allocation in human-agent collaboration; examines when systems should offer user control vs autonomous action; supports mixed-initiative agency.

sources.title: Human Oversight-by-Design for Accessible Generative IUIs
sources.notes: 2023 arXiv on designing for human oversight in generative UIs; demonstrates transparency and explainability mechanisms enable user agency in AI-generated interfaces.

sources.title: Participatory Design Landscape for the Human-Machine Collaboration, Interaction and Automation at the Frontiers of HCI
sources.notes: 2022 arXiv synthesizing participatory design approaches for human-machine systems; emphasizes user empowerment and democratic agency in design of autonomous systems.

sources.title: Complementarity in Human-AI Collaboration: Concept, Sources, and Evidence
sources.notes: 2024 arXiv on complementary human-AI collaboration; argues for designs where AI augments rather than replaces human judgment; preserves human agency and decision-making authority.

sources.title: How to Achieve Explainability and Transparency in Human AI Interaction
sources.notes: Springer chapter on XAI frameworks for human-AI interaction; connects explainability to user control, trust, and informed decision-making in AI systems.

sources.title: Human-controllable AI: Meaningful Human Control
sources.notes: 2025 arXiv on meaningful human control architectures in AI systems; establishes technical requirements for maintaining human agency, control authority, and override capabilities.

sources.title: Autonomy Reshapes How Personalization Affects Privacy Concerns and Trust in LLM Agents
sources.notes: 2025 arXiv demonstrating how user autonomy (risk-contingent control) mediates tension between personalization and privacy; supports agency through transparent control mechanisms.

sources.title: Mixed-Initiative Context: Structuring and Managing Context for Human-AI Collaboration
sources.notes: Foundational work on mixed-initiative systems allowing dynamic control allocation; establishes framework for systems that maintain user agency through shared decision-making authority.

sources.title: Neural Transparency: Mechanistic Interpretability Interfaces for Anticipating Model Behaviors for Personalized AI
sources.notes: 2025 arXiv on interpretability interfaces for personalized AI; demonstrates how transparency enables user understanding and predictability in adaptive systems, supporting perceived control.

sources.title: User Control in Adaptive User Interfaces for Accessibility
sources.notes: Springer chapter addressing user control in adaptive accessibility interfaces; discusses tension between automated personalization and user agency; privacy and transparency trade-offs.

sources.title: Factors Influencing Perceived Fairness in Algorithmic Decision-Making: Algorithm Outcomes, Development Procedures, and Individual Differences
sources.notes: 2019 arXiv on perceived fairness in algorithms; demonstrates transparency and user understanding influence fairness perceptions and sense of just agency in algorithmic systems.

sources.title: The 2025 AI Agent Index: Documenting Technical and Safety Features of Deployed Agentic AI Systems
sources.notes: 2025 comprehensive index of deployed AI agent systems; documents autonomy levels, control mechanisms, safety features; enables comparative analysis of user agency support across systems.

sources.title: Explaining explainability: A comprehensive survey on explainable artificial intelligence and relevant industry applications
sources.notes: 2024 comprehensive survey of XAI literature; maps explainability techniques to user control, trust, and agency; industry applications demonstrating XAI impact on adoption.

sources.title: Agent Teaming Situation Awareness (ATSA): A Situation Awareness Framework for Human-AI Teaming
sources.notes: 2023 arXiv framework for situation awareness in human-AI teams; establishes principles for maintaining human operator agency through understanding and predictability of agent behavior.

sources.title: Negotiating the Shared Agency between Humans & AI in the Recommender System
sources.notes: 2024 arXiv examining shared agency in recommendation; addresses control negotiation, user resistance, and the need for bidirectional influence between user and system.

sources.title: The State of the Art in Integrating Machine Learning into Visual Analytics
sources.notes: 2020 survey on ML-visual analytics integration; addresses maintaining user agency and exploratory control when systems automate analysis steps; transparency and user guidance.

sources.title: Modeling and Leveraging Analytic Focus During Exploratory Visual Analysis
sources.notes: CHI 2021 paper on user focus in visual analysis; demonstrates how system modeling of user intent can support agency while automating routine tasks.

sources.title: Crowdsourcing historical photographs: autonomy and control at the Copenhagen City Archives
sources.notes: 2021 CSCW empirical study of autonomy and control in crowdsourcing; demonstrates how system design affects user autonomy, participation, and sense of agency.

sources.title: Understanding sustained participation in crowdsourcing platforms: the role of autonomy, temporal value, and hedonic value
sources.notes: 2021 empirical study showing autonomy (work scheduling, task, method) drives sustained participation in crowdsourcing; establishes autonomy as key motivational factor.

sources.title: Explainable AI in 2025: Navigating Trust and Agency in a Dynamic Landscape
sources.notes: 2025 industry perspective on XAI and agency; highlights business case for explainability (25% revenue growth, 34% cost reduction); connects XAI to user trust and adoption.

sources.title: Self-Efficacy Theory: Bandura's 4 Sources, Mastery Leads
sources.notes: Practitioner synthesis of Bandura's self-efficacy in gamification context; applies psychological control theory to engagement design and motivation.

sources.title: Mental Models and User Control in Interaction Design
sources.notes: Interaction Design Foundation summary of Norman's mental model theory; explains mode errors, user control, and design principles for reducing confusion and supporting agency.
